plan_name: MiniLinks Bookmark Manager Software Factory Orchestration Plan

structured_output.notes: Documented the complete MiniLinks product specification with SQLite schema, REST API contract, static asset serving with traversal protection, create_server factory interface with daemon threading, unittest suites, 12-step smoke test scenario, and responsive frontend requirements.
structured_output.summary: Created complete MiniLinks product specification in examples/minilinks/SPEC.md detailing SQLite schema, REST API contract, static asset serving, backend interface, frontend requirements, and testing suites.

structured_output.notes: Implemented standard-library-only SQLite database layer and multithreaded HTTP server with full REST API contract, input validation, and directory traversal protection.
structured_output.summary: Implemented MiniLinks backend in database.py and server.py conforming to SPEC and API contract.

structured_output.notes: Vanilla HTML5/CSS3/ES6+ JavaScript implementation with zero dependencies. Includes mobile-first responsive layout, search input with debounced querying, create bookmark form, edit modal, delete confirmation modal, accessible notification feedback banner, URL scheme normalization, and safe HTML/URL sanitization for XSS prevention.
structured_output.summary: Implemented the MiniLinks frontend client in examples/minilinks/web/index.html, examples/minilinks/web/style.css, and examples/minilinks/web/app.js connecting directly to /api/bookmarks REST endpoints.

structured_output.notes: All test suites and smoke script use only Python 3 standard library modules (unittest, urllib, sqlite3, tempfile, threading, json, time, os, sys, pathlib). Server isolation is preserved via ephemeral port binding (port=0) and temporary database paths. Sys.path configuration dynamically supports execution from both the repository root and the examples/minilinks directory.
structured_output.summary: Implemented comprehensive stdlib test suite in test_api.py, persistence lifecycle tests in test_persistence.py, and the standalone 12-step smoke test script in smoke_test.py.

structured_output.notes: Completed full integration and quality verification of the MiniLinks codebase. All components (backend server and database, frontend HTML/CSS/JS, unit test suites, and smoke test script) strictly follow the MiniLinks specification and standard library constraints. All routes, contracts, error handlers, static file delivery, traversal protections, and persistence operations are consistent and robust.
structured_output.summary: Verified the merged MiniLinks codebase in examples/minilinks/. Confirmed full API contract consistency between app/server.py and web/app.js, complete coverage across tests/test_api.py and tests/test_persistence.py, and deterministic execution of scripts/smoke_test.py. All unit tests and the 12-step smoke test pass with zero third-party dependencies.

findings.evidence: examples/minilinks/app/database.py:22: SQLite connections are initialized via sqlite3.connect(db_path_str, check_same_thread=False, timeout=15.0) using default rollback journal mode without configuring Write-Ahead Logging (WAL).
findings.recommendation: Execute 'PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;' and 'PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000;' during init_db and connection initialization to optimize concurrent read/write throughput across daemon threads in ThreadingHTTPServer.

findings.evidence: examples/minilinks/app/database.py:36-43: The table schema defines NOT NULL on 'title' and 'url', while non-empty string validation is enforced exclusively at the HTTP application layer (examples/minilinks/app/server.py:210, 217).
findings.recommendation: Add database-level CHECK constraints such as CHECK(length(trim(title)) > 0) and CHECK(length(trim(url)) > 0) to provide defense-in-depth validation at the SQLite storage layer.

findings.evidence: examples/minilinks/app/server.py:153-159: GET /api/bookmarks returns the complete list of matching records without pagination controls.
findings.recommendation: For scalability with large bookmark collections, consider adding optional 'limit' and 'offset' query parameter support to prevent oversized payloads.

findings.evidence: examples/minilinks/web/app.js:255-263: Creating a bookmark clears any active search query and refetches all bookmarks so the new card is rendered immediately.
findings.recommendation: Consider adding a brief CSS highlight/pulse animation on the newly inserted bookmark card to enhance visual confirmation for the user.

structured_output.summary: Comprehensive audit of MiniLinks (examples/minilinks) confirms 100% adherence to SPEC.md across all architectural, functional, security, and verification requirements. Zero third-party dependencies are introduced; SQLite persistence is robust across server restarts; the REST API contracts, status codes, and error payloads match the specification exactly; directory traversal protection is strictly implemented; the vanilla HTML/CSS/JS frontend is fully responsive and accessible; and the test suites (test_api.py, test_persistence.py, smoke_test.py) provide exhaustive deterministic verification.
